newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late rubber SIR20 stable, SIR3CV up.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late rubber SIR20 stable, SIR3CV up.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 offer prices were stable in late trading on Wednesday, while SIR3CV were up on an expected higher demand, dealers said.
Dealers said January SIR20 offer prices were at 55.00-55.50 cents/lb fob Medan, 54.75-55.25 fob Surabaya, Padang and Palembang, 54.00-54.50 fob Pontianak and Jambi.
One Jakarta dealer said Singapore firms bought January SIR20 at 54.75 fob Medan and at 54.50 fob Surabaya.
Another dealer in Medan said SIR3CV was on offer at 142 cents/kg, up from the previous 141 but no deals were done so far.
Latex dealers said high amoniac latex was likely to increase to 2,230 rupiah/kg fob Medan for January shipments from 2,200 rupiah due to an expected rising demand.
